style.summary: Opal sets frosted-glass cards on near-black #0E0F11 screens, lit by ice-blue #B4D4E6 numbers, rings and glows. Cards round at 33 pt continuous corners with a faint white rim, and every button is a glass capsule 42 to 51 pt tall. Photo-real 3D stones and gems crown the hero screens and float in the store art.

traits.label: Layout
traits.text: Screens center one hero, a 293 pt ring or a 3D gem, above glass cards with 20 pt inner padding.

traits.label: Shapes
traits.text: Glass cards: 33 pt continuous corners, a white rim at 18%; buttons and value pills: full capsules 42 to 51 pt tall.

traits.label: Color
traits.text: Near black #0E0F11 behind #EEEEEE titles and #BCBBC0 body text; ice blue #B4D4E6 and a #819DC4 to #9FF8FE gradient mark numbers and rings.

traits.label: Type
traits.text: SF Pro mixes Medium and Bold words in one headline at 4% tight tracking; 12 to 14 pt spaced caps label the stats.

traits.label: Imagery
traits.text: Photo-real 3D stones, gems and rock arches appear on 6 of 8 shots, over misty ice-blue backdrops.

traits.label: Components
traits.text: A 293 pt screen-time ring with a 22.5 pt ice-blue arc, glass app tiles, and a capsule stepper with 37 pt round buttons.

trial.evidence: "Start Free Week" on the Yearly tab and "Start Free 3 Days" on the Monthly tab of the web pricing page

ourRead: Yearly opens preselected at $8.29 a month, though $99.99 / 12 is $8.33. Monthly shows $19.99 and "$239 billed annually", so $99.99 a year reads as 58% off.
The trial follows the plan: 7 days on Yearly, 3 on Monthly, and Lifetime goes straight to "Purchase". The default plan gets the longest trial.
Lifetime at $399, 4 times the yearly price, anchors the top of the ladder. The App Store also lists weekly plans at $4.99 and $9.99.
stylePrompt:
Restyle my app in Opal's style. Keep my features, data and copy.
Colors:
- 60% near black #0E0F11: screen backgrounds, with a #495C6B glow at the top.
- 30% soft white #EEEEEE: titles and icons; body text #BCBBC0.
- 10% ice blue #B4D4E6: key numbers, rings, active icons; arcs fade #819DC4 to #9FF8FE.
Type:
- Headlines: Inter 700, close to SF Pro, 28 pt, tracking -4%, key words Bold inside Inter 500 lines.
- Body: Inter 500, close to SF Pro, 13 to 15 pt; stat labels about 12 pt caps, tracking 5%.
Shapes:
- Glass cards: background blur, white rim at 18%, 33 pt continuous corners.
- Buttons and steppers: capsules 42 to 51 pt tall.
Layout:
- 32 pt side margins, one centered hero per screen, 20 pt card padding.
Components:
- Ring: 293 pt, 22.5 pt round-capped arc on a #151515 track, 55 pt value centered.
- Stat row: 3 columns, caps label over an ice-blue number of about 28 pt.
- Glass button: 42 pt capsule, white label, ice-blue glow on the bottom rim.
Icons and imagery:
- White rounded line icons; one photo-real 3D stone or gem per hero.
Check:
- Every background is #0E0F11 or its top glow.
- Cards show the background through frosted glass.
- Headlines mix 2 weights.
